tagline: 爱克发折叠相机，1937 年发布
description: 爱克发于1937年推出的折叠相机。配备8.5 cm f/6.3 Igestar, f/4.5 Agnar, f/4.5 Apotar or f/4.5 Solinar.。快门速度Vario, Pronto, Prontor II, Compur or Compur-Rapid.。使用12 exp. 6x6 or 16 exp. 4.5x6 on 120 type rollfilm.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 12 exp. 6x6 or 16 exp. 4.5x6 on 120 type rollfilm.
specs.快门: Vario, Pronto, Prontor II, Compur or Compur-Rapid.
specs.镜头: 8.5 cm f/6.3 Igestar, f/4.5 Agnar, f/4.5 Apotar or f/4.5 Solinar.
specs.英文简介: The Isolette is the name of a series of compact horizontal-folding camera for twelve 6×6 cm (2¼-inch square) pictures or sixteen 4.5×6 cm (2¼×1⅝ inch) pictures (only on the first model of the camera), on 120 film.
